title: Ramakrishna, Vivekananda, Theosophy: more bodies and detail

boxes.title: Ramakrishna & Vivekananda: more
items: Ramakrishna's other guru: **Bhairavi Brahmani** (Tantra); Totapuri = Advaita; wife ==**Sarada Devi**==
Vivekananda: "**Prophet of Indian Nationalism**", "Maker of Modern India"
Chicago also: **P.C. Mozoomdar** (Brahmo), **Virchand Gandhi** (Jain), **Anagarika Dharmapala** (Buddhist, Ceylon)
Mission: monastic order + lay disciples; schools, hospitals, orphanages, famine relief
Belur Math blends **Hindu, Islamic, Christian** motifs; permanent HQ of the Order

boxes.title: Theosophy & Arya Samaj: more
items: Beliefs: ==**karma and reincarnation**==; drew on Upanishads, **Samkhya**, Yoga, Vedanta
Condemned child marriage; uplift of outcastes and widows
Besant **1847-1933**; INC session at **Calcutta**; ⚠ Home Rule: one note says 1915
Arya split cause: Western vs Vedic education and **diet**; **Pandit Gurudutt** carried on Dayananda's work

boxes.title: Wider angles
items: Common features: rationalism, education, ==women's emancipation==, attack on caste
Political role: cultural confidence vs colonial "inferiority" narrative; Theosophy led into **Home Rule**
Comparison: RKM = service and universalism; Theosophy = ==foreign-founded Hindu revival==
